pieces.Text: A season sage can infuse living things with the essence of a season with a touch, causing them to manifest the changes associated with that season-for example, a touch of winter can make some animals grow a thick winter coat, while a touch of summer can make them shed. A touch of autumn would make a deciduous tree's leaves change colors, a touch of winter would make its leaves fall, and a touch of spring would make it put forth new leaves. In addition, a season sage can use the following abilities (in any combination)
times per day. [Vernal Growth] A touched living creature gains the effects of enlarge person (even if it is not a humanoid) for
minutes. A touched non-creature plant likewise doubles in all dimensions for the same duration. [Summer Might] A touched creature gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Constitution for
minutes. [Autumn Rot] A touched creature or object made of plant matter takes
